title: Overnight oats
summary: Mix it in two minutes tonight, eat it tomorrow. No cooking at all.
source: Written for REMY by Claude as a simple demo. Checked by Matthew on 2026-11-07.
equipment: Jar or bowl with a lid
notes: It needs at least 4 hours (ideally overnight) in the fridge before eating. Keep it in the fridge and eat it within 2 days.
ingredients: Toppings: berries, banana, nuts or seeds

steps.instruction: Put the oats, milk, yoghurt and honey in the jar and stir well.
looks_wrong: dry oats sitting on top (stir more)
too little milk (it'll be stodgy: add a splash)
steps.done_when: Everything is mixed and the oats are covered.

steps.instruction: Put the lid on and leave it in the fridge for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
looks_right: lid on, jar going into the fridge
looks_wrong: left out on the counter overnight (milk and yoghurt need the fridge)

steps.instruction: In the morning, stir it, add a splash of milk if it's too thick, and top with fruit.
looks_wrong: very thick and stiff (stir in more milk)
steps.done_when: Topped and ready to eat cold.
